item.title: 'CA did not interview Josh Hazlewood, Starc or Lyon': David Warner makes fresh bombshell claim on ball-tampering, accuses Cricket Australia of 'cover up'
item.description: Former Australia opener David Warner has accused Cricket Australia (CA) of covering up details of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal, questioning the governing body's investigation into the incident. In another development in the controversy that rocked Australian cricket, Warner claimed that CA did not interview Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc or Nathan Lyon during its investigation in the days after the Cape Town Test in 2018. Warner made the allegation in an Instagram post on Saturday, a day after accusing Test captain Pat Cummins of throwing Usman Khawaja under the bus following the release of Khawaja's memoir, Sabr. His latest comments came a day after Cummins addressed the allegations made in Khawaja's book during a lengthy press conference. The Australia captain dismissed the claims as “complete and utter nonsense”. “As far as I am aware, CA did not interview Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc or Nathan Lyon in their 2018 investigation,” Warner posted to Instagram. “If that’s correct, then how can CA push the idea that the bowlers didn’t know? “It looks like they had decided who they wanted to blame from the very beginning ran a shoddy investigation to serve the purpose and now they want to maintain the false narrative that the bowlers had no idea. That stinks of a cover up.” View this post on Instagram A post shared by David Warner (@davidwarner31) The ball-tampering scandal has returned to the spotlight after Khawaja made several claims while promoting his book, alleging that the entire Australian team knew about the plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the Cape Town Test. Cummins rejected those claims on Friday, while CA has previously said it has no intention of reopening the investigation into the incident. Warner had also responded to Cummins' comments on Friday afternoon, ahead of Australia's opening ODI of the summer against England. He said he felt "the captain today threw Uzzie under the bus". The former Australia opener followed that up with another Instagram post on Saturday, questioning the way CA handled the investigation. Warner and then captain Steve Smith were handed one-year bans by CA following the incident, while Cameron Bancroft received a nine-month suspension.

item.description: Liverpool forward Lewis Koumas made his Wales debut against Gibraltar in June 2024 [Getty Images] Amid Wales' striker struggles, one of the nation's true footballing greats feels one man could come to Craig Bellamy's rescue. Ian Rush, the record scorer for the men's side until being surpassed by Gareth Bale in 2018, faced competition from the likes of Mark Hughes and Dean Saunders during his 16-year Wales career. The Red Dragons are sorely lacking top quality and depth at present, though, in a position where they have been blessed with talent in years gone by. It is a situation that has worsened this week after Kieffer Moore withdrew from the squad for the crucial Nations League double-header with Norway and Portugal because of injury. But Liverpool legend Rush believes Anfield prospect Lewis Koumas could help to ease Bellamy's forward concerns on the back of his impressive start to the campaign with the Reds. "He's [Koumas] had a fantastic few months," Rush told BBC Sport Wales. "It's been an absolutely fantastic experience for him, and he's loving it as well. "I think now is the time for Wales, whether he starts or not, I think he'll be more experienced now. "It'll be interesting if Craig plays him or not as a number nine. I think with Kieffer Moore out, he might play him as a number nine because, what he's doing, he's helping all the others. He might not score, but he's helping everyone else out." "I'm not sure he's number nine, but I'll tell you what, what he gives to the team is something special," added Rush. "One thing I know with him, you're going to get 100%. He'll run around all day. item.title: FIT Roundup: Treasure Coast, South Fork bounced from postseason
item.description: Here’s a roundup of FIT high school football playoff games involving Treasure Coast teams played on Thursday, Nov. 12. Treasure Coast and South Fork each qualified for the 6A-4A South FIT bracket. The Titans hosted their postseason game while the Bulldogs were on the road. FIT - 6A-4A South 3OT - No. 6 North Miami (5-6) 20, No. 3 Treasure Coast (6-5) 17 The Titans had their multiple chances to advance. Instead, their bounce-back season came to a crushing close in triple overtime at the hand of the Pioneers at Lawnwood Stadium. Treasure Coast led 10-3 late in regulation before the visitors tied it up. On a fourth down, Aden Francois hit a quick pass to Renel Alincy, who slipped by a tackle and raced down the sideline for a 39-yard touchdown with 36.3 seconds left. Choosing a kneel down on the ensuing possession, the Titans got the ball first and scored on a short plunge from junior athlete Elyansky Pierre, his second touchdown of the night. North Miami quickly tied it with an Alincy touchdown reception to force a second overtime, but Treasure Coast appeared to be in the driver’s seat when Pierre intercepted a Francois pass. The Titans elected to try a field goal on the second play of their possession, but the attempt was blocked, continuing the night. Stopped on three plays to start the third overtime, Treasure Coast missed a short field goal. That opened the door for Jason Lobo, who booted a 27-yard attempt off the left upright and through to give the Pioneers the win. Treasure Coast followed a winless campaign in 2025 with a winning season in 2026. No. 2 Santaluces (5-6) 34, No. 7 South Fork (7-4) 28 Fourth-quarter turnovers harmed the Bulldogs’ chances of an upset road win against the Chiefs. The two teams were tied 21-21 entering the fourth, South Fork fumbled on the first play of the quarter. The fumble was returned for a touchdown. Intercepting a pass on the Bulldogs’ next drive, Santaluces scored off the turnover, going ahead by two scores with 8 minutes, 44 seconds left. Senior quarterback Champ Smith trimmed South Fork’s deficit with a 15-yard rushing touchdown with 2:14 remaining, but the Chiefs hung on to get the victory. Smith had three total touchdowns. He had a 25-yard touchdown pass to Jarrod Kelly and a 6-yard touchdown pass to Ezekiel Pata. Anquan Kerr added a 9-yard rushing touchdown. The Bulldogs finished 2026 with their first winning season since 2015. Patrick Bernadeau is a sports reporter for Treasure Coast Newspapers. item.title: AUS vs ENG 1st ODI: Inspired by Mitchell Johnson of 2013-14, Mahli Beardman runs through England on debut
item.description: CHENNAI: At a time when Australian cricket could do with some good news, 21-year-old Mahli Beardman provided a glimmer of hope. The young fast bowler made an extraordinary impression on his ODI debut, claiming 6/24 in 7.4 overs to dismantle England on a lively Perth pitch in the series opener. England were bundled out for 131 in 33.4 overs, with Australia subsequently chasing down the target in 23.3 overs to seal a convincing win and take a 1-0 lead in the three-match ODI series. Beardman recorded the best bowling figures by an Australian on ODI debut and the fourth-best overall. He also needed just 28 deliveries to complete his five-wicket haul, the fastest by an Australian in the format. The young right-arm fast bowler has grown up admiring two fast-bowling greats — Mitchell Johnson and Dale Steyn. There was a familiar aggression to the performance, in addition to the knack of trying to pitch the ball up and inducing the edge. He got dismissed Harry Brook and Joe Root with deliveries that got the edges and followed it up with short-pitched stuff as well that completely dismantled the English line-up. It was in Oct that Beardman was going all guns blazing in Puducherry for Australia ‘A’, setting up a series win in the 50-over format. During the tour, when TOI caught up with Beardman, the pacer said: “Johnson’s 2013-14 Ashes campaign against England left a huge impression on me. Watching him bowl with that aggression really fuelled my interest in fast bowling. Steyn was my favourite. I followed him closely growing up and even tried to replicate his bowling action. Those two were my biggest inspirations,” Beardman said. Beardman values the opportunity to learn from Australia’s celebrated pace trio of Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Mitchell Starc , having already picked their brains during previous assignments. “Bowling alongside them would be a fantastic opportunity. Starc has been particularly generous with his advice, while Pat and Josh have also been helpful whenever I’ve had the chance to interact with them,” he said. Brief scores: Australia 132-3 in 23.3 overs (M Marsh 50) beat England 131 in 33.4 overs (M Beardman 6-24, S Johnson 3-42) by seven wickets.

item.title: Catalan outlet uses statistics to claim refereeing double standards favour Real Madrid over Barcelona
item.description: Catalan outlet uses statistics to claim refereeing double standards favour Real Madrid over Barcelona Real Madrid and Barcelona remain locked in an intense battle for the La Liga title, with Hansi Flick’s side enjoying a three-point lead over their arch-rivals. However, Jose Mourinho’s side earned early bragging rights by securing a 2-1 away victory at the Spotify Camp Nou in the first league Clasico . The rivalry has often extended beyond the pitch, with Mundo Deportivo suggesting that the two Spanish giants are being treated differently by referees this season. Striking difference in foul statistics According to the Catalan outlet, Real Madrid have benefited from a significant statistical advantage in terms of fouls received and committed across the opening 12 league matches. Los Blancos have received 171 fouls, the highest in La Liga , while committing just 102, the lowest figure in the competition. This leaves Jose Mourinho’s side with a favourable differential of +69. Barcelona, on the other hand, have received just 122 fouls despite dominating possession. Jose Mourinho’s team have been the most fouled in La Liga. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Meanwhile, 130 fouls have been awarded against them, resulting in a negative differential of -8. The figures also reveal some interesting individual numbers. Jude Bellingham leads La Liga in fouls received with 31 , followed by Kylian Mbappe and Vinicius Junior with 23 each and Arda Guler with 21. Lamine Yamal has received only 20 fouls despite being among the league’s most prolific dribblers. Do the numbers really indicate refereeing favouritism? The report argues that these figures suggest inconsistent refereeing standards. Even in the recent Clasico , Barça conceded 15 goals compared to Madrid’s 11. However, while the statistical disparity is undeniable, it does not necessarily establish refereeing bias. Lamine Yamal has been fouled at a similar rate to Kylian Mbappe. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) Real Madrid play on the counter-attack and have pacy attackers, often forcing opponents to commit fouls to stop them. This style of football can skew foul numbers in their favour, while Barcelona play a very different style. The only attacker whose style resembles that of Los Blancos ‘ forwards is Lamine Yamal. The Spanish teenager’s foul tally is quite similar to Kylian Mbappe’s. Thus, there is nothing in these numbers that particularly stands out. Real Madrid cannot afford to worry about such claims of refereeing bias and need to focus on closing the three-point gap at the top after the international break.

item.title: Fighting blind: Paralympian takes on MMA challenge
item.description: Chris Telesford has an eye condition so rare he’s thought to be one of the only people in the world with it [BBC] Chris Telesford was just one month old when he was diagnosed with an eye condition so rare that ocular specialists around the world have studied his eyes ever since. He has bilateral coloboma of the optic nerve with nystagmus and has been treated at Moorfields Eye Hospital all his life. "It means I've got both short- and long-sightedness in both eyes at the same time. One pupil is misshapen and the cataract made everything blurry and distorted," he said. Now 46, Telesford has been part of the Paralympic GB Taekwondo Poomsae team since 2018. This weekend, he's believed to be the first person with a bilateral visual impairment to compete in a mixed martial arts contest against a sighted opponent. "Seeing is difficult, very difficult," he said, adding that the lighting and the number of people around him can impact on how well he can see. We are sitting in Stone Fight Academy boxing gym in Welling, south-east London, where Telesford is training for his latest quest. Sitting directly in front of him about a metre or so away with a studio light illuminating us both, I asked him what he could see of me. "I can see that you are slightly shorter than me, but because of the light you're more or less just a silhouette," he replied. Telesford uses light and shadows and instincts to work out his bearings on the mats. Chris can only see me as a silhouette, even though I am sitting relatively close to him [BBC] Poomsae is a form of Taekwondo that doesn't use one-on-one combat, but combines defensive and offensive movements against imaginary opponents. He is the UK's number one. Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) couldn't be more different: it's all about the one-on-one combat. "MMA is more violent," he said. "It's more full on." "You can grab, you can punch to the face, you can take down, practice submissions, grappling and so forth. "Basically your ultimate aim is to hurt the other person," he said. "And I'm not fighting someone who's got a visual impairment. Everyone I'm fighting is able-bodied." Coach Mark Smith from Stone Fight Academy says MMA combines a variety of martial arts [BBC] This Sunday at the Clapham Grand, Telesford is competing in an Ultra MMA event - a charity fundraising programme that gives beginners eight weeks of mixed martial arts training before competing in a supervised amateur bout. His coach, Mark Smith, said: "Chris turned up at the gym one day wanting to branch out from what he was already doing which was taekwondo, and get into something a little bit more full-contact, which was MMA. "It combines boxing, kickboxing, wrestling, Brazilian jujitsu, and is kind of a blended mix of all." Because Sunday's fight is for charity, Smith won't be in his corner giving out instructions, but he will be watching in the audience. item.title: The NBA players who appear to have regressed most so far in 2026-27
item.description: Although it's early, we've got enough of a sample size to observe some league-wide trends, such as potential player regressions, which is what we're here to discuss today. Early-season regressions can often be just an illusion, as some players may get off to cold shooting starts, throwing off their games; they could enter a season out of shape and need a month or so to get into game shape before they start looking like their prime selves again; or they could be dealing with undisclosed early-campaign nicks. Regardless, this season, there have been some players who have gotten off to slow starts that have been quite suprising. So let's talk about them. Nikola Jokic (Denver) 2025-26 stats : 27.7 ppg, 12.9 rpg, 10.7 apg, 56.9 FG%, 38.0 3P% 2026-27 stats : 23.5 ppg, 10.8 rpg, 9.0 apg, 50.0 FG%, 23.3 3P% It almost feels asinine to discuss Nikola Jokic in a negative light, as he remains an All-NBA-level performer and an extremely impactful player, one who makes his team 9.7 points per 100 possessions better and who ranks Top 5 in VORP and BPM. However, Jokic hasn't been at his usual otherworldly self this season; it's the first time in four years that he doesn't lead the league in both of the aforementioned advanced metrics, while his Denver Nuggets are just 6-4 through 10 games and look like a Play-In-caliber team, at least as things stand now. That's all to say: Jokic remains a top-level player, but he hasn't played like the franchise-carrying supernova that he's been since 2020-21. Could this be a sign of age and his lack of elite fitness starting to catch up to him? Or is it simply a slow start for the Serbian superstar, one in part caused by his three-point shot being ice-cold at the moment? We're starting to think it could be a bit of the latter, as over his past five games, Jokic's numbers are starting to look more Jokic-like at 25.8 points, 11.8 rebounds, 8.8 assists, 2.0 steals and 1.0 blocks per game. Joel Embiid (Philadelphia) 2025-26 stats : 26.9 ppg, 7.7 rpg, 3.9 apg, 48.9 FG%, 33.3 3P% 2026-27 stats : 17.9 ppg, 8.8 rpg, 3.7 apg, 37.4 FG%, 11.1 3P% It's somewhat ironic that the two players who brought the center position back to the forefront are the first two players we discuss here, but we couldn't mention Jokic and not bring up his former rival in so many MVP races, Joel Embiid , as a player who has also regressed mightily this season. Injuries have held Embiid to 39, 19 and 38 games over the past three seasons, respectively, and it's entirely possible that those constant health issues have made it so we'll never see a prime Embiid again. If that is the case, that would be unfortunate for NBA fans, as the big man was absolutely dominant in his prime, a 7-footer who could shoot, drive, post-up, create for teammates and block shots on the other end of the floor, as well as gobble up rebounds. Embiid's statistical regression could be a matter of usage, too, as the former Kansas standout has a career-low 28.4 percent usage rate in 2026-27.

item.title: Proof: Real Madrid enjoy huge advantage over Barcelona in La Liga foul statistics
item.description: Proof: Real Madrid enjoy huge advantage over Barcelona in La Liga foul statistics Barcelona and Real Madrid are experiencing contrasting treatment in La Liga’s foul statistics, with Hansi Flick’s side committing more fouls while receiving considerably fewer free-kicks than their biggest rivals. The numbers, covering the opening 12 league matches of the 2026-27 season and highlighted by Mundo Deportivo , show an intriguing difference between the two title contenders. As such, Barcelona have committed 130 fouls and received 122, producing a negative differential of eight. Real Madrid, meanwhile, have committed just 102 fouls while winning 171, giving them a remarkable positive differential of 69. The contrast raises questions about how the two teams are experiencing refereeing decisions, especially at a time when Los Blancos continuously campaign against refereeing standards in the league. Real Madrid enjoy significant advantage over Barcelona Barcelona are the second least-fouled team in La Liga, behind only Real Sociedad, who have received 113 free-kicks. Barcelona ahve conceded the second-fewest number of fouls in La Liga this season. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Despite dominating possession and frequently attempting to progress through opposition pressure, the Catalans have not received the same number of referee decisions in their favour as Real Madrid. As for Los Blancos, Mourinho’s team occupy the opposite end of the comparison. Their 171 fouls received are the highest in the division, while their 102 committed are the fewest. Furthermore, the individual statistics reinforce the contrast, as Fermin Lopez has committed 16 fouls, while Lamine Yamal, who has won 20 fouls, and Xavi Espart have registered 13 each. Conversely, Jude Bellingham leads the league for fouls won with 31. Kylian Mbappe and Vinicius Jr. have 23 apiece, while Arda Guler has drawn 21. The El Clasico example Cucurella was never penalised for his challenges on Lamine Yamal. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) The October 25 meeting at Spotify Camp Nou, which Barcelona lost 1-2, offered a particularly relevant illustration. Marc Cucurella repeatedly challenged Lamine Yamal, with several incidents generating frustration among Barcelona fans. Several supporters highlighted the defender’s aggressive approach towards the young winger, while football pundits also questioned the decision not to award a free-kick when Yamal went down under Cucurella’s pressure late in the match. Now, there will be a debate regarding the matter, but the aforementioned statistics certainly bring forward a key question: if Real Madrid are indeed winning more fouls than any other team, why do they criticise La Liga officials? More importantly, is their campaign against referees influencing these statistics? If so, where is the transparency?

item.title: Breaking down Springfield area high school football district championship action
item.description: SPRINGFIELD — Hardware was handed out to some teams, while others shed tears. It was the district championship for high school football in Missouri on Friday, Nov. 14. The playoffs continue to be wild, with upsets and crazy finishes. Here’s everything that happened to Springfield area teams in the district title game. Nixa hangs on to defeat red-hot Ozark There isn’t a single team in the area that has improved more as the season went along than Ozark (6-6). Nixa felt Ozark’s wrath throughout the district championship game. The Eagles had to hold on to a 34-27 win to secure the title. Nixa (10-2) coach John Perry took to social media , calling Ozark’s performance the best he’d seen in seven years. Ozark had the ball at Nixa’s 10-yard line with less than 10 seconds to play. Down a touchdown, Ozark tried to fire pass after pass to the end zone from quarterback Caden O’Donnell. Fair Grove football: Eagles turn whiteboard motivation into district championship reality Nixa used its own starting quarterback, Adam McKnight, to play defensive end. McKnight went around the edge and sacked O’Donnell to end the game. Nixa’s big-play ability was too much for Ozark. Nixa trailed 14-13 at halftime with its back against the wall. McKnight threw two of his three touchdown passes in the first half. He found Carter Mabe from 35 yards and Austin White from 60. Ozark countered with a 1-yard rushing score from Jett Easley. Easley also caught a 12-yard touchdown reception before halftime. Nixa came out of the locker room with all of the momentum. They scored back-to-back touchdowns. McKnight rushed for a 5-yard touchdown and threw a 30-yard bullet to Reed Wilson. Ozark didn’t give up as the team secured big play after big play. Easley scored another rushing touchdown and O’Donnell found Mereck Putt for a 23-yard touchdown. The back-to-back touchdown drives delivered Ozark a 27-26 lead with 9:39 left in the game. When Nixa needs it, they put the ball in their star quarterback’s hands. He scored the game-winning touchdown through a 48-yard rush down the near sideline. item.title: Negreira case investigation effectively closed as Real Madrid await crucial Barcelona financial documents
item.description: Negreira case investigation effectively closed as Real Madrid await crucial Barcelona financial documents The Negreira case remains one of the biggest controversies rocking Spanish football at the moment. Real Madrid continue to push for answers over Barcelona’s financial relationship with the former vice-president of the Spanish refereeing committee. Now, according to Que T’hi Jugues , the judicial committee has officially concluded its witness hearings. Only certain financial documents from Barcelona remain outstanding before a decision can be made on whether the case proceeds to trial. Former Barcelona officials defend usefulness of referee reports Former Barcelona B manager Gerard Lopez and ex-delegate Toni Alonso were the final witnesses to testify before investigating judge Alejandra Gil on Friday. Both defended the usefulness of the refereeing reports prepared by Javier Enriquez, son of former refereeing official Jose Maria Enriquez Negreira. Lopez coached Barcelona’s reserves between 2015 and 2018 and explained how reports on refereeing tendencies helped, especially in the lower divisions. Luis Enrique denied knowing of the technical reports that are at the centre of the Negreira case. (Photo by JAVIER SORIANO / AFP) (Photo by JAVIER SORIANO/AFP via Getty Images) Their testimony, however, contrasts with that of former first-team managers such as Luis Enrique and Ernesto Valverde. The two managers claimed that they were unaware of the reports or had never used them in any capacity during their time at the club. Barcelona continue to maintain that the payments were exclusively for technical consultancy services and not an attempt to influence refereeing decisions. Real Madrid await final documents before crucial judicial decision Real Madrid had requested a six-month extension to the investigation, alongside the prosecution, but the judge rejected the request in September. Nevertheless, Los Blancos successfully secured a partial ruling from the Barcelona Provincial Court requiring Barcelona to submit financial audits and reports covering 2010 to 2021. These are the documents still outstanding from the Catalan club before the investigation officially concludes. Real Madrid are closely following the proceedings of the Negreira case. (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) Once the documents are received, Judge Gil is expected to decide, potentially in early 2027, whether to dismiss the proceedings or send the case to trial. The investigation concerns payments reportedly totalling €8.4 million over 17 years to Negreira and related companies. Real Madrid are closely following the proceedings because, should Barcelona be found guilty, no other club would have been more affected than them. It remains to be seen how Judge Gil assesses the findings of this investigation and whether the case goes to trial in 2027.

item.title: “She’s so good on the ball”: Eva Olid lavishes praise on surprise player ahead of Crystal Palace match
item.description: “She’s so good on the ball”: Eva Olid lavishes praise on surprise player ahead of Crystal Palace match Manchester United Women manager Eva Olid has been speaking to the media ahead of her side’s home match in the Women’s Super League (WSL) against Crystal Palace. Squad updates Olid admitted she was still waiting for physio reports, but the only player definitely out is Scarlett Hill , who will be out of action for weeks. Hanna Lundkvist form The Catalan coach praised her side’s tactical performance versus Aston Villa last weekend and singled out the Swedish international Lundkvist for special praise. Olid explained, “I think she’s a player who can play in different positions. She can play as a full-back, a wing-back or a wide centre-back. With the national team, she’s also playing as a number six.” She continued, “she’s so good on the ball. She’s a player who can come inside and can play out wide. As a manager, you always like having those kinds of players because you know they’re versatile and can play in different positions, giving different things to the team.” Crystal Palace threat Explaining the type of threat Palace will pose, she asserted, “I expect a very competitive match. They’ve been having good matches, especially their last result against Tottenham on Wednesday. It was a very competitive match, and they could have won the game.” Olid continued, “for that reason, I expect a really good match, tactically and in terms of intensity. She added, “I know it’s repetitive, but we’re still in a process. We know there are a lot of things we have to improve. She explained, “I think all teams are motivated when they play against Manchester United in general. item.description: Devon Booker of the Suns © X/@Suns Amid the Phoenix Suns’ struggles this season, Devin Booker has resurfaced in trade rumors. On Friday, Eric Pincus of Bleacher Report floated the idea of Phoenix sending Booker to the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for CJ McCollum, Dorian Finney-Smith, Corey Kispert, rookie Kingston Flemings, and a protected 2028 first-round pick. Suns color analyst Eddie Johnson wasn’t feeling this idea, however. The 17-year NBA veteran mocked Pincus’ proposed trade with a four-word retort. “Put down the (tequila)!” Johnson tweeted on Friday. — Eddie A Johnson (@Jumpshot8) November 13, 2026 Though Booker continues to shoot efficiently in his 12th NBA campaign, his 25.5 points per game is his lowest scoring average in the past seven seasons. Still, the five-time NBA All-Star is a solid playmaker, putting up 5.0 assists per game while cutting down his turnovers to 2.5 a night. Booker is far and away the Suns’ best offensive weapon, but his individual numbers haven’t translated into team success early in the season. Holding the 11th spot in the Western Conference with their 5-6 record, the Suns got off to a 1-5 start before bouncing back with four wins over the past eight days. On offense, the Suns have been middling, ranking 15th with an offensive rating of 113.8. Phoenix has fared even worse on the other end of the floor, as their bottom-5 defense has allowed opponents to shoot 46.5% from the field and 37.4% from deep. Phoenix has plenty of areas to fix, but in Johnson’s eyes (a Suns forward in the late 80s), trading Booker isn’t a viable solution. Appearing on SiriusXM NBA Radio this past Wednesday, insider Mike Scotto said that Booker remains the face of the franchise. “From every indication I’ve gotten, the Phoenix Suns want to keep Devin Booker, and they want to continue to build around him…And, for Devin Booker, every indication I’ve gotten is he still wants to be a Sun for life.” As for finding a court general to relieve Booker of playmaking duties, there happens to be a former All-Star guard with his eyes on the Valley. Speaking after the final whistle, the Dortmund midfielder laughed off the long-standing debate regarding his compatibility with the Barcelona man. The two creative forces had rarely shared the pitch as a starting pair until now, but their telepathy in Amsterdam suggested that the concerns were largely unfounded. "Yes, if you never try it, you won't know either," Veerman told ESPN Netherlands . "It happened for the first time today. He is 29 and I am almost 28 years old. item.description: Dearns moved to Japan from the Hawke's Bay region of New Zealand as a 14-year-old [Getty Images] Warner Dearns didn't want to go to Japan. Now, he doesn't want to leave. A decade ago, Dearns' father Grant got a job as a strength and conditioning coach with top-flight Japanese side NEC Green Rockets, taking the family from New Zealand's North Island to a satellite city outside Tokyo. For Dearns, like most 14-year-olds, swapping class-mates, countries, continents and cultures didn't appeal. "I said I didn't want to go," says the second row, who will co-captain Japan against England at Allianz Stadium on Saturday. "My sister and I wanted to stay with our grandma and grandad [in New Zealand]." But, reluctantly, they made the trip, with Dearns' mother Tanya, a former New Zealand netballer, giving up her own coaching job to help the family settle in Japan. "The first year or two took a bit to adapt to, it is a very different culture from New Zealand, and the language barrier didn't help much either," remembers Dearns. "At high school there was no-one else who spoke English. I was the kid who stood out, the only one with blond curly hair, so it was lots of fun." There were other reasons that Dearns stood out. Even as a teenager, he stood 6ft 8in tall and weighed more than 19 stone (120.6kg). In New Zealand, Deans had been more interested in basketball than rugby. But at Kashiwa Senior High School – one of Japan's strongest rugby-playing schools – they moulded him into a monster prospect. To supplement his size and galloping, long-legged sprint, Dearns' school coaches introduced gymnastics into his training schedule, having him hurdle team-mates and perform flips, to improve his agility around the pitch. item.description: Stats: Barcelona maestro records incredible 99% passing accuracy in 45 minutes vs Greece Barcelona midfielder Frenkie de Jong needed just 45 minutes to show his importance to the Netherlands, delivering an impressive individual performance in their 7-0 victory over Greece in the UEFA Nations League. Captaining the Oranje in the absence of the injured Virgil van Dijk, De Jong dictated proceedings from midfield under head coach Xavi Hernandez. Although he was withdrawn at half-time with the Netherlands already leading 5-0, the statistics he produced showed the influence he had on the team’s performance. As such, the 29-year-old completed 79 of his 80 passes , achieving an outstanding 99% accuracy across 84 touches. His distribution was equally impressive over longer distances, completing all three of his attempted long passes . Frenkie de Jong statistics highlight his midfield dominance De Jong’s contribution was not just related to his work in possession. The Barcelona midfielder won all three ground duels he contested and successfully completed his only attempted aerial duel . His ability to combine defensive involvement with progressive distribution was particularly valuable. Rather than simply circulating possession, De Jong consistently helped the Netherlands move the ball into advanced areas and maintain control of the contest. De Jong explains why he did not play the second half Despite his impressive performance, De Jong did not return after the interval. The decision was influenced by the comfortable scoreline and his recent return from injury. Frenkie de Jong produced a masterclass display against Greece. item.title: Football kit giveaway aims to boost participation
item.description: Millie Bright said she wanted girls to feel "comfortable and confident" in their kit [BBC/Sally Hurst] Former England captain Millie Bright has helped hand out new kit to grassroots football teams in Leeds as part of an initiative aimed at keeping girls in sport for longer. Thirty teams based in communities facing social or economic challenges were chosen by anti-discrimination charity Kick it Out for the donation. Bright, who began her career at Doncaster Belles, said it was "vital" to keep girls playing sport. "Every young girl deserves a kit, no matter what level they play at, and, whilst the top of the game is doing really well, real life still exists. People can't afford to give their children kits, but that doesn't mean they should go without." Craig Gilmore set up Champions CIC, in Beeston, six years ago, to provide free Saturday morning training for children in the local area, as well as breakfast and lunch. "With the cost of living, football's expensive [and] bills come first," he said. "We work with a lot of families that can't afford the direct debits and the ongoing costs of grassroots sport nowadays. "The new kit is amazing. It gives them that sense of belonging, that team pride, it's a massive boost for them." Bright spoke with young footballers during the event in Leeds [BBC/Sally Hurst] The new kit was provided by Kick it Out, in partnership with the Morrisons Foundation. They hope it will inspire these girls to continue sport as young women and adults. "Girls' participation struggles with drop-out rates," said Gemma Clark, from Kick it Out. "One of the barriers is kit. We want to remove that barrier so that more local girls can keep playing." Bright told the BBC she was fully behind the campaign. "As a girl or a woman, it's about feeling wanted and equal," she said. "We deserve to have kits. I don't want to see any girl dropping out of the game because they don't feel valued or comfortable. "These are the days that really make a difference. Hopefully this shows the girls that the people at the top care. The power of having a kit is a small gesture, but has a massive impact." item.description: (Photo by Harry How/Getty Images) Getty Las Vegas Raiders‘ Maxx Crosby was in the trade speculation conversation leading up to the Nov. 10 deadline. However, the veteran edge rusher remained with the Silver and Black, as the only move they made was trading Kirk Cousins to the Minnesota Vikings. The Raiders are in Year 1 of the Fernando Mendoza era, which will begin in Week 10 against the Seattle Seahawks on Nov. 15. Nonetheless, the question will be whether some of the veteran players on this team will be around once Las Vegas has turned the situation around. Although Crosby is under contract until after the 2029 season, NFL insider Jason La Canfora noted that one general manager doesn’t see the veteran edge rusher staying in Las Vegas until that contract is up. “He was effectively dealt last March,” La Canfora wrote in a FanSided article on Nov. 13 . “That was a done deal to Baltimore as far as the Raiders were concerned. They aren’t going to get two first-round picks like the Ravens had on the table, but execs think they can get one, plus a day-two pick. “And with that defense still in deep disrepair, the Raiders are going to need to load up on potential young blue-chip players on that side of the ball. They are still going to be two offseasons away from competing. ‘I don’t think he plays out this contract there,’ one GM told me of Crosby in Vegas .” Maxx Crosby on Hearing His Name in Trade Speculation Before the trade deadline, Crosby spoke about his name being in the trade speculation conversation. Nonetheless, the veteran is 100 percent committed to being with the Raiders. “I don’t pay attention to that at all,” Crosby told reporters after the loss to the 49ers on Nov. 8 . “I play for the Raiders; I expect to play for the Raiders, and that’s all that matters to me. I love this team and plan on being here for a very long time. “There’s always narratives, and there’s always people who supposedly have all this insider information. I speak very clearly because everyone’s got an opinion, but nobody really knows. Everyone who comes out with these random stories out of nowhere is just trying to get attention and generate clickbait. That’s just part of the game.” Crosby has played 539 total snaps for the Raiders this season, resulting in an 85.0 overall PFF defensive grade .
